propositions: Spent ~1 GiB of unreachable history in the tickets-store must be reclaimed via length-aware git fast-export/filter/fast-import history strip followed by repack and gc
Pre-rewrite diagnostic repair (ticket 30d3) must complete with zero repairable issues and exactly four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED records before the history rewrite begins
Off-repo bundles must be created before and after repair, verified with git bundle verify, and restored to confirm manifest OIDs before any live mutation
Rewritten repository state must be validated to maintain identical tree, commit count, merge-count, identity multiset, and lack of old-tip ancestry before and after publication
Post-rewrite initial writer must be isolated with REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_DRAIN=off and constrained to one canonical four-commit sequence with sub-1 MiB incremental growth

All operational receipts (session pause, bundle verification, identity equivalence, publication success, first-write isolation, workflows restart, final fsck) must be operator-attested and recorded before maintenance window close
